verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own event-driven rule features: Alerts that dispatch to Slack and PagerDuty, Ownership Rules for automatic issue assignment, Crons-triggered alerts, and Webhooks as an outbound action target. Most of this evidence is page titles, so the depth of rule conditions and actions is unshown. missing for 10: documented rule condition/action configuration (triggers, filters, thresholds, action chaining), evidence of automated non-notification actions such as auto-launching Seer or a coding agent from a rule, and independent hands-on corroboration.
